question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

question: List the names of all top-level product categories.
sql: SELECT name FROM categories WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL;

question: How many products are currently discontinued?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 0;

question: What is the most expensive product? Give its name and price.
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many customers are in the platinum loyalty tier?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'platinum';

question: Which products are out of stock? Show their names.
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE stock_quantity = 0;

question: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

question: What is the average product rating across all reviews?
sql: SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews;

question: List the distinct brands we sell, alphabetically.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT brand FROM products ORDER BY brand;

question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE strftime('%Y', signup_date) = '2024';

question: How many customers do we have in each country?
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;

question: What is the total amount of failed payments?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed';

question: Show the 5 cheapest active products with their prices, cheapest first.
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 5;

question: How many orders had free shipping?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shipping_cost = 0;

question: How many payments were made with each payment method?
sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) FROM payments GROUP BY method;

question: How many products are in the Headphones category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Headphones';

question: What was the total revenue from delivered orders in 2024?
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024';

question: Which brands have at least 7 products? Show brand and product count.
sql: SELECT brand, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7;

question: What is the average rating of each brand's products? Show brand and average rating.
sql: SELECT p.brand, AVG(r.rating) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand;

question: How many orders did each loyalty tier place?
sql: SELECT c.loyalty_tier, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier;

question: List the email addresses of customers who have never placed an order.
sql: SELECT email FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders);

question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025? Show the month as YYYY-MM.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: What is the total quantity sold of each product category (subcategory level)? Show category name and units.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name;

question: Which products have fewer than 5 reviews? Show product name and number of reviews.
sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(r.review_id) FROM products p LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) < 5;

question: What is the average shipping cost of orders from customers in Germany?
sql: SELECT AVG(o.shipping_cost) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany';

question: Which city has the most customers? Give the city and the count.
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many 1-star reviews did products from the brand Voltix receive?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.brand = 'Voltix' AND r.rating = 1;

question: What is the profit margin (price minus cost) of each active Laptop product? Show name and margin, highest first.
sql: SELECT p.name, p.price - p.cost AS margin FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Laptops' AND p.is_active = 1 ORDER BY margin DESC;

question: How much money was refunded in total for each year? Use the payment date.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', payment_date) AS yr, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'refunded' GROUP BY yr;

question: List customers with more than 10 orders: first name, last name and order count.
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

question: What share of orders were returned, as a percentage of all orders?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders;

question: Which payment method brought in the most completed payment amount?
sql: SELECT method FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY method ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many distinct customers bought something from the Camping category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Camping';

question: What is the average number of items (sum of quantities) per order?
sql: SELECT AVG(q) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS q FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: Show the number of reviews per rating value, from 5 stars down to 1.
sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating DESC;

question: What was the total revenue per top-level category for delivered orders? Show top-level category name and revenue, highest first.
sql: SELECT top.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY top.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend on delivered orders? Show email and amount spent, highest first.
sql: SELECT c.email, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each year, what was the month with the most orders? Show year, month (YYYY-MM) and order count.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS yr, strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY month), r AS (SELECT yr, month, n, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY n DESC) AS rk FROM m) SELECT yr, month, n FROM r WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY yr;

question: Which products have an average rating below 3 with at least 5 reviews? Show name, average rating and review count.
sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating), COUNT(*) FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND AVG(r.rating) < 3;

question: What was the year-over-year growth in delivered-order revenue from 2024 to 2025, as a percentage?
sql: WITH y AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY yr) SELECT 100.0 * (b.rev - a.rev) / a.rev FROM y a JOIN y b ON a.yr = '2024' AND b.yr = '2025';

question: List customers whose first order was in 2025: email and date of first order.
sql: SELECT c.email, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING strftime('%Y', MIN(o.order_date)) = '2025';

question: What is the gross profit (revenue minus product cost) of delivered orders for each brand? Show brand and profit, highest first.
sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.cost)) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY profit DESC;

question: Which customers have bought products from at least 4 different subcategories? Show email and the number of subcategories.
sql: SELECT c.email, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) >= 4;

question: For each country, what is the average order value of delivered orders, including shipping? Show country and average, highest first.
sql: WITH ov AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.shipping_cost + SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT c.country, AVG(ov.value) AS avg_value FROM ov JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ov.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY avg_value DESC;

question: What is the best-selling product by units in each top-level category? Show category, product name and units sold.
sql: WITH u AS (SELECT top.name AS category, p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id GROUP BY p.product_id), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS rk FROM u) SELECT category, product, units FROM r WHERE rk = 1;

question: How many customers placed orders in both 2024 and 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025');

question: Which delivered orders have no completed payment? Show the order ids.
sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments pay WHERE pay.order_id = o.order_id AND pay.status = 'completed');

question: What is the running total of delivered-order revenue by month in 2024? Show month and cumulative revenue in month order.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month) FROM m ORDER BY month;

question: Which brands have an average review rating higher than the overall average rating? Show brand and its average.
sql: SELECT p.brand, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.brand HAVING AVG(r.rating) > (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews);

question: What percentage of gold and platinum customers have written at least one review? Show tier and percentage.
sql: SELECT c.loyalty_tier, 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.loyalty_tier IN ('gold', 'platinum') GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier;
